title: The Best Bags for a Day of Sightseeing

body_markdown:
You leave the hotel with a few stops in mind. By lunch, you've found a bookstore, taken more photos than expected, and decided the market across town is worth the walk. A good sightseeing bag can keep up with that kind of day.


The best day bag for sightseeing gives you enough room for what you want to bring along, keeps the things you need easy to find, and feels right with what you're wearing. Here's how to choose one for the way you like to explore.


## Best Bag for an All-Day Itinerary


When you'll be out from morning until dinner, start with what you actually plan to bring. A wallet and phone are one thing. Add a small umbrella, sunglasses, a snack, and the little things you collect throughout the day, and pockets become much more useful.


### Small Banbury Backpack: Room to Stay Organized


The[Small Banbury Backpack](https://verabradley.com/products/small-banbury-backpack-5375324252) is a good compact bag for day trip plans that cover a lot of ground. Its adjustable straps leave your hands free for maps, photos, and whatever you pick up along the way. An exterior zip compartment keeps frequently used items separate from the main compartment, while two side pockets let you bring a water bottle or[compact umbrella](https://verabradley.com/search?q=umbrella&options%5Bprefix%5D=last&productListPgNo=1) .


**Dimensions:** 7" w, 11.75" h, 4.75" d


> "Super cute pattern and I love the lightweight material! Love the size for travel and love that you can still fit a water bottle in the side!" ~ Lauren


### Lorman Sling Backpack: A Lighter Way to Roam


The[Lorman Sling Backpack](https://verabradley.com/products/lorman-sling-backpack-5407720089) has a narrower shape for days when you're carrying less. Its convertible strap lets you wear it over your left or right shoulder, so you can choose what feels comfortable as you move through the city.


Two exterior zip compartments give essentials their own spots, with a back slip pocket and a slip pocket in the main compartment to stash your phone,[wallet](https://verabradley.com/collections/wallets-and-wristlets) and more. It's a great choice when you want the ease of a backpack in a slimmer style.


**Dimensions:** 6.5" w, 11" h, 2.75" d


> "Very sturdy and stylish, holds just enough for a day trip or traveling." ~ Margaret


## Best Bag for Hands-Free Exploring


A crossbody makes sense when the day involves walking, browsing, and moving between activities. How much you bring will help you decide whether you want a compact bag or more space.


### Becker Camera Bag Crossbody: Just the Essentials


The[Becker Camera Bag Crossbody](https://verabradley.com/products/becker-camera-bag-crossbody-5504724251) is for the traveler who knows what she needs and brings exactly that. Its compact shape measures 8.25" wide, 5.5" high, and 3" deep, so it's an easy choice for a few hours of sightseeing or an evening out.


A front zip pocket and back slip pocket give you places for items you reach for often; inside, two slip pockets and a zip pocket help keep your phone, wallet, keys, and small necessities in order. The adjustable strap lets you settle it where you like, and the zip closure keeps the main compartment secure between stops.


**Dimensions:** 8.25" w, 5.5" h, and 3" d


> "Small, but holds the essentials I need. Love the wide strap as it sits comfortably on my shoulder." ~ Nancy


### Harwick Large Messenger: More Room, Same Freedom


If you prefer a crossbody but want one that holds more, look to the[Harwick Large Messenger](https://verabradley.com/products/harwick-large-messenger-5632824375) bag. Its structured silhouette adds a polished touch to an outfit, while its generous size gives you more room than a compact camera bag.


Harwick's front zip pocket has two slip pockets inside, handy when you want to find small items without opening the main compartment. Two back slip pockets add quick-access storage, and an interior zip pocket and two slip pockets help organize what you carry inside. It's a strong contender for the best bag for city sightseeing when your plans take you from morning coffee to an afternoon museum and on to dinner.


**Dimensions:** 11.5" w x 11.0" h x 3.5" d


> "Hands free and large enough to carry whatever you may need for any occasion. Enough pockets too to make it easy to find everything." ~ Rita


## Best Bag for Carrying Layers, Snacks, and Souvenirs


Some itineraries practically invite you to bring something home. If you're visiting markets, stopping in shops, or carrying a few extra items for the kids, a tote or roomier handbag can make more sense than a small crossbody. Check the dimensions against what you plan to carry, especially for bulkier layers or purchases.


### Small Original Vera Tote: A Little Extra Room


Our[Small Original Vera Tote](https://verabradley.com/products/small-original-vera-tote-5525824251) is a petite version of a familiar favorite. Its clean shape works for a museum day or a market visit, while the zip closure helps keep everything together as you move between stops.


Six interior slip pockets give your smaller essentials places to land, so they're easier to find when you need them. An exterior slip pocket and zip pocket add options for the things you want to reach quickly. That shape gives you some flexibility for the day's extras without asking you to carry a full-size tote.


**Dimensions:** 11.5" h, 4.5" d, 11.5" w at its base, with a wider 16.25" opening at the top


> "Love the design and size. My go to purse for traveling and carrying a good book to read with me!" ~ Katrina


### Hathaway Reversible Tote Bag: Space and Style Options


When you want maximum flexibility, step up to the[Hathaway Reversible Tote Bag](https://verabradley.com/products/hathaway-tote-5624824383) . It's a large capacity tote bag that's easy to carry thanks to the comfortable 12” handle drop. As an added bonus, the bag is fully reversible so you can match any outfit or occasion on your trip.


No matter which side you choose, an exterior slip pocket keeps your phone and necessities easy to reach while an interior slip pocket gives an extra option for organization. The unstructured style can fit a few items secured with a hidden magnetic closure, or leave the top open for those bigger shopping finds and travel take-alongs.


**Dimensions:** 13.0" h x 6.25" d, 13.75" w at its base, with a wider 20.5" opening at the top


> "Perfect size for a quick trip out shopping. Love the style." ~ Teresa


## Best Bag for a Day That Runs Into Dinner


Sightseeing plans have a way of growing. If you'd rather keep the same bag for an afternoon of wandering and dinner afterward, choose one that fits how you want to carry it.


### Original 100 Handbag: The Vera Bradley Classic


The[Original 100 Handbag](https://verabradley.com/products/original-100-handbag-5621724255) brings Vera Bradley's original silhouette along for the trip. The most organized shoulder bag you'll ever have, it features three exterior slip pockets and five interior slip pockets. This is a particularly welcome detail when you've gathered receipts, tickets, sunglasses, and the other small traces of a day well spent.


Its quilted cotton lining and familiar shape give it a character all its own. With a zip closure and 13.5" handle drop, it's a lovely choice for someone who wants a classic handbag that you can throw over your shoulder comfortably.


**Dimensions:** 11.0" w x 5.75" h x 5.5" d


> "This is a great bag, handles are long enough to put on your shoulder with a coat on. Great pockets inside and outside." ~ Sherrie


### Clara Convertible Shoulder Bag: Ready for the Next Stop


The[Clara Convertible Shoulder Bag](https://verabradley.com/products/clara-convertible-shoulder-bag-5588324254) has a clean, polished shape that feels at home no matter where your sightseeing day takes you. Carry it by its handles while you browse, then attach the removable, adjustable strap when you want your hands free for the walk to dinner.


At 12" wide, 9.25" high, and 2.75" deep, Clara has room for your daily essentials without the bulk of a larger tote. A zip closure keeps the main compartment covered, and an interior zip pocket gives smaller items a place to stay put.


**Dimensions:** 12" w, 9.25" h, and 2.75" d


> “It is so light weight and the perfect size. A really nice new thing is that both straps can be used and removed at will. It makes the bag super versatile.” ~ Iris


## So, Which Bag Comes With You?


Choose for the day you're planning, then leave a little room for the day you might have. The Small Banbury suits a longer itinerary with more to organize. The Lorman keeps a lighter load close. Becker carries the essentials, while Harwick gives crossbody fans more room. The Small Original Vera Tote and Original 100 Handbag suit days with extra stops and a few finds; Clara moves easily into evening plans.


The best bag is the one you'll be glad you brought at hour seven, when you spot one more street you want to walk down.
